name: WebSocket
description:
> Create WebSocket connections from the main process using Chromium's native networking library

Process: Main

`net.WebSocket` is a drop-in replacement for the WHATWG `WebSocket` interface that routes the connection through Chromium's network stack rather than Node.js. Use it when you want a main-p

members.name: send
members.desc: Enqueues `data` to be transmitted to the server. Throws an `InvalidStateError` `DOMException` if `readyState` is `CONNECTING`.

members.name: close
members.desc: Closes the connection. Calling `close()` while still `CONNECTING` aborts the handshake.

members.name: url
members.desc: A `string` representing the resolved URL of the connection.

members.name: readyState
members.desc: An `Integer` representing the current state of the connection: one of `WebSocket.CONNECTING` (`0`), `WebSocket.OPEN` (`1`), `WebSocket.CLOSING` (`2`), or `WebSocket.CLOSED` (`3`).

members.name: bufferedAmount
members.desc: An `Integer` representing the number of bytes of application data that have been queued via `send()` but not yet handed off to the network.

members.name: protocol
members.desc: A `string` containing the subprotocol selected by the server. The empty string until the connection is open or if the server did not select a subprotocol.

members.name: extensions
members.desc: A `string` containing the extensions negotiated by the server (for example `permessage-deflate`).

members.name: binaryType
members.desc:
A `string` controlling how incoming binary messages are exposed on the `message` event. Can be `nodebuffer`, `arraybuffer`, or `blob`. The default is `nodebuffer`.

`'nodebuffer'` is an Electron exten

members.name: onopen
members.desc: A `Function | null` event handler for the `open` event. Equivalent to calling `addEventListener('open', ...)`.

members.name: onmessage
members.desc: A `Function | null` event handler for the `message` event. Equivalent to calling `addEventListener('message', ...)`.

members.name: onerror
members.desc: A `Function | null` event handler for the `error` event. Equivalent to calling `addEventListener('error', ...)`.

members.name: onclose
members.desc: A `Function | null` event handler for the `close` event. Equivalent to calling `addEventListener('close', ...)`.

members.name: CONNECTING
members.desc: An `Integer` constant equal to `0`, the `readyState` value while the opening handshake is in progress.

members.name: OPEN
members.desc: An `Integer` constant equal to `1`, the `readyState` value once the connection is established.

members.name: CLOSING
members.desc: An `Integer` constant equal to `2`, the `readyState` value while the closing handshake is in progress.

members.name: CLOSED
members.desc: An `Integer` constant equal to `3`, the `readyState` value once the connection is closed.
